intro: Creators whose success online I'm genuinely happy about. Each one shows a different way to win in AI and tech content, and each has a style worth studying.

creators.name: Nate Herk
style: Step-by-step builds of AI agents and automations
A big Skool community behind the channel
creators.borrow: The closest model to your plan: free build tutorials on YouTube that lead into a Skool community. Copy the structure, then add your Delivery Pilot angle.

creators.name: Nate B Jones
style: Daily AI news and strategy commentary
Big-picture takes on what AI means for work and business
creators.borrow: The Pillar 2 model: grounded takes on AI and work, delivered consistently. Proof that big-picture commentary works when it's sharp and regular.

creators.name: Tina Huang
creators.focus: Learning AI, data and tech careers
style: Learning-focused: how to learn AI and build skills
creators.borrow: Matches your 'learning by myself through video' passion. Package what you learn into clear, structured lessons.

creators.name: NetworkChuck
style: A signature ritual and urgent 'learn this now' titles
creators.borrow: Energy and urgency for Pillar 1 tool videos. See the Inspiration page for the full breakdown.

creators.name: Alex Finn
style: Fast, energetic builds with AI coding tools
Shows real apps being made quickly
creators.borrow: The 612-repos side of you: show the build loop fast, from idea to agent to shipped app.

you.label: 🧑‍✈️ You
you.note: Both pillars (practical and big-picture) and high energy (Extraversion 85). The gap in the map is practical builds with a big-picture 'why' and energy. That's your spot.

lessons: 🎯 Every one of them has one clear lane. Pick yours and repeat it.
📅 Consistency beats intensity: daily (Nate B Jones) or weekly (most others), on a schedule viewers can rely on.
🏫 Several turn viewers into a community or product, which is your Skool and Delivery Pilot path.
🎙️ Their style matches who they are. Yours is energetic, direct and curious, so lean into it.
